# Isaiah Chapter 11 -- The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

## Consensus Translation

*[Full consensus translation of all 16 verses]*

*Spirit-anointed ruler from Jesse; peaceful kingdom; knowledge of God fills earth; second exodus*

---

## SOPHIA's Council Notes

Isaiah chapter 11 (The Shoot from Jesse) addresses spirit-anointed ruler from jesse; peaceful kingdom; knowledge of god fills earth; second exodus. The key verse — "The wolf shall dwell with the lamb, and the leopard shall lie down with the young goat" — captures the chapter's central message. This chapter belongs to First Isaiah (chs. 1-39), focused on judgment and the Assyrian crisis.
